The Vec collect is there to avoid holding the listeners RefCell across callbacks, which is correct. To remove the per-change allocation, keep listeners as a copy-on-write snapshot `RefCell<Rc<[(u64, Listener)]>>` rebuilt only in add_modifier_listener and ShortcutRegistryEntry::drop, and have handle_key clone the Rc snapshot (one refcount bump, no allocation). Listener changes are rare, so the rebuild cost moves off the key path.

Drop the RefCell: retained_builder's build closure is `Fn` and only reads `value`, so capture it directly with `move |state, context, _| { ... value.child.clone() ... }` and remove the `let value = value.borrow();` line (line 65).
